main.description: Get a private-tier post thread. Requires auth by a ready community member. At most 200 nodes (anchor, parents and replies); unauthorized or missing children and parents are omitted, and the parent chain stops at the first missed parent. Audiences this AppView resolves: `list` (the audience record's members); `followers` (followers of the audience's owner who are ready members of this AppView, by the follow records it has indexed, which reflect a new follow or an unfollow within about a minute); `everyone` (every ready member of this AppView, not the network); and `nobody`. A `following` audience is not resolved yet and is served to its author only, as is any other mode. A block record or a private block between the reader and the author, or the audience's owner, in either direction, keeps the reader out; a block through a list does not.

depth.description: How many levels of replies to include.

parentHeight.description: How many levels of parent posts to include.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: Post not found. Returned identically whether the anchor does not exist or is not visible to the requester.

errors.name: NotEnrolled
errors.description: The caller is not a community member of this AppView.

errors.name: NotReady
errors.description: The caller's account indexing is still in progress.
